title: ICON 1.5 — Out of Combat
description: Narrative play: action rolls, effort and strain, burdens and ambitions, clocks, camp and interlude.

steps.title: Between the fights
steps.content: Outside combat ICON is a story game: you roll your narrative actions, spend effort, take strain, and the GM tracks clocks. This tour shows where each of these lives.

steps.title: Action rolls
steps.content: Click an action's name to roll it: one d6 per dot, keep the highest. 1-3 fails, 4-5 succeeds with a cost, 6 succeeds (pp.16-17). The window asks for boons and curses (never more than +2 or −2 in total) and offers Push Effort: spend 1 effort for one more die. The result goes to chat.

steps.title: Effort, strain, burdens, ambitions
steps.content: Effort: click a box to spend it; Recover All refills it. Strain: the harm you take to avoid worse; when it fills up you break and take a burden (pp.30-31). Burdens and Ambitions are clocks: add one with +, click a segment to fill it, pick its size.

steps.title: Aid and set up
steps.content: Helping each other is not a button. An ally who aids spends 1 effort and doesn't roll: you get +1 boon, and they share the consequences. A set up costs no effort: the helper rolls first, and if it succeeds you get +1 boon or a bigger effect. You can't have both on one roll (pp.19-20, 34-35). Add the boon in the roll window. The Quick Guide explains the difference, next step.

steps.title: The Narrative tab of the Quick Guide
steps.content: The action roll, risk and effect, push, aid and set up, effort and strain on one page, with the page of the book for each. It is searchable, like the glossary and the FAQ.

steps.title: Clocks
steps.content: The GM keeps campaign clocks on a Clock Board actor (Create Actor → Clock Board): click the segments to fill them, post a clock to chat, hide it from the players, or drag it onto the map. Players see the clocks that aren't hidden.

steps.title: Camp, interlude, XP
steps.content: The ICON Macros compendium has the GM's tools for the end of a scene or a session. Camp: everyone back to full HP, strain and vigor cleared, effort refilled. Interlude: also wounds healed and burden segments cleared, with Dust for extra ones (p.42). Award Session XP: ticks the XP triggers for the characters you pick. Drag a macro to the hotbar to use it.

steps.title: That's it
steps.content: Bonds, bond powers and gear kits are in the Character Sheet tour; the optional Heroic and Routine rolls in the GM's House Rules tour.
